definition: a choice between two equally bad options
description: A wet riverside path on a cloudy spring day with blossom trees and an old lamp post. A young woman in a blue tweed jacket, white skirt and white trainers stands stuck in the middle, holding her head with both hands. On her left a brick tunnel under the path is flooded with brown water that covers the way. On her right a large grey goose spreads its wings and hisses at her, blocking the path ahead. At the end she throws her arms out wide in despair. A railway bridge crosses in the background.

taps.phrase: to clutch her head in panic

de.answer: Sie fasst sich panisch an den Kopf.
